description: False colour composite satellite image from Spot 5 (2.5 m resolution, 1/2/3 band combination) showing land cover delineation near a water body. The image displays vegetation in shades of red and pink. A large, irregularly shaped polygon, outlined in light blue, covers an area labelled "1400" (magenta box), which corresponds to a golf course with managed pinkish-red vegetation and small white features. To the east of this polygon, there is a dark blue/black area representing a water body. To the southeast, an area of dense, darker red vegetation is labelled "3210" (red text), indicating dense forest or natural vegetation. A thin green-yellow line outlines the boundaries of land parcels and the water's edge.
